notes.title: Build Update - 08.07.2019
notes.content:
Helloooo Citizens of Gamindustri!

The developers have implemented a new build that addresses the issues below!

[h1][b]Update Notes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix for animation issues during break attacks
[*] Fix for missing FX
[*] Fix for freezes during gameplay
[*] Fix for UI graphical issues 
[*] Added mouse wheel support
[/list]

Thank you all for your patience and support!

Please report any issues to our PC Support team at [url=http://ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php]http://ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php[/url]!

tags.bug: Fix for animation issues during break attacks

notes.title: Additional Party Members SET DLC is NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Greetings Gamindustri!

We are happy to announce that the [b]Additional Party Members Set DLC[/b] is now available for purchase [b]($2.99)[/b]! The DLC set includes:
[list]
[*][b]Party Member [Artisan][/b]
[*][b]Party Member [IF][/b]
[*][b]Party Member [Compa] [/b]
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1082579/Additional_Party_Members_Set____Personnages_jouables_additionnels/

You can access all three party members from the start of the game!

Best,
Iffy Team

notes.title: Uzume Tennouboshi Joins the Re;Birth series as a New Party Member!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1050122][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/9b8b5eb7c34d19020326c3b978d7edf80d362a29.png[/img][/url]

We're excited to announce that [b]Uzume Tennouboshi AKA Orange Heart[/b] is [b]NOW AVAILABLE[/b] as a new party member for the [i]Re;Birth[/i] series! The [b]"Uzume Battle Entry"[/b] DLC is available for [b]all 3 [i]Re;birth[/i] games for $1.99 each[/b].

[h1][b]How to Unlock Uzume's DLC:[/b][/h1]
With the [b]Uzume Battle Entry DLC[/b], an event will occur when you access "Information" at Planeptune. Here, Uzume can now join your party!

*You must progress to Chapter 2.
*If this DLC event was already seen, it will not occur again.
